purpose: UI comparison concepts, not implemented specifications

prompts.prompt:
Create a single high fidelity Japanese indie game HUD redesign concept, landscape aspect 1120:800. Input image is reference for the existing game and visual style ONLY, redesign HUD according to variant below. Preserve simple muted dark green top-down arena with three plain olive rectangular obstacles (upper left, middle, lower right), tiny pixel-art female gunner left and white robot right, small ammo pickup, sparse orange/blue bullets. Do not create fancy environment, perspective or character portraits. Restrained charcoal UI, ivory legible typography, orange P1 and blue CPU, minimal borders and glow. Clearly reserve HUD bands outside gameplay; no UI covering actors or projectiles. This is CPU duel.
Shared contents: round 'ROUND 4', timer '48' and small '秒', modest score '2 — 1' with small '5本先取'. Timer legible but not enormous, score subordinate to health/ammo. P1 'リナ', health '6.5 / 8'; CPU 'ボルト', health '10 / 10'. Use continuous HP fill at 81.25% and 100%, no inaccurate discrete ticks. Active candy gun '跳弾キャンディ', large '12', explicitly separate magazine '装弾' and reserve '予備 48', no ammo tick strip. Small inactive weapon icons in numbered slots. Relics only compact symbolic placeholder icons, no individual names or description, one icon has ×2, a temporary relic has purple dashed border and tiny clock badge. No big relic cards or empty relic slots. Own abilities: '回避' with key 'SPACE' and dark cooldown ring '0.8秒'; '近接' with key '右クリック' and neutral ready icon; 'パルス' key 'Q' and '3'. Never Q for dodge, never E for melee, never R for pulse. Small 'R 装填' by ammo if space; E means weapon switch only. Correct Japanese. Enemy has NO gun name, weapon cards, or ammo HUD. Enemy can hold gun in arena. Tiny opponent relic icons must be inside labeled CPU panel, never floating loose in arena. No giant ability glows when idle. Short optional supply notification near pickup only. No marketing, no explanations outside screen, no variant title inside game. Fit all within safe margins. STANDARD BALANCED LAYOUT: Top band about 95 logical px tall: left P1 wide HP bar and health number, center round/timer/modest score, right CPU matching health and a row of four tiny relic icons within panel. Bottom band 140px: upper row is OWN complete weapon strip, all EIGHT numbered slots 1 through 8 shown as compact icon slots with active slot 2 highlighted; active candy gun detail and large ammo anchored left in the same dock, inactive icons small. Lower row has a compact strip of ten distinct relic icons (28px) and three modest abilities on right. Group ammo and abilities close, no full height cards for relics. Large clear central arena. Readability is more important than decorative borders. This variant solves max eight weapon inventory while retaining top-versus health layout.
